mandate: C416 — test the cross-sectional intraday QREG: QUANTILE-REGRESSION SLOPE OF ASSET RETURN ON EQUAL-WEIGHT MARKET at tau in {0.1, 0.5, 0.9} plus quantile-slope spread stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; equal-weight market return m[s]=(1/10)*sum_i r_i[s]. QREG scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns: for each bar t, X=r_i[t-W+1..t], M=m[t-W+1..t], fit the quantile regression of X on M with intercept at tau via linprog minimizing sum rho_tau(residual), rho_tau(u)=u*(tau-1{u<0}); qreg_slope_0.1/0.5/0.9[t]=quantile-regression slope b(tau); qreg_spread[t]=qreg_slope_0.9[t]-qreg_slope_0.1[t]. Needs indices t-W+1..t (W bars). NaN if t<W, any NaN/non-finite in window, or fit not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (qreg_slope_0.1_dev, qreg_slope_0.5_dev, qreg_slope_0.9_dev, qreg_spread_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid fit; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window or not finite or fit not finite).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|; market m[s]=mean across assets.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns, tau in {0.1,0.5,0.9}; qreg_slope_tau[t]=quantile-regression slope b(tau) via linprog; qreg_spread[t]=qreg_slope_0.9[t]-qreg_slope_0.1[t].
methodology.signals: qreg_slope_0.1/0.5/0.9/qreg_spread over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.qreg_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; market m[s]=mean across assets; zero-copy sliding_window_view(R,256) and sliding_window_view(m,256); per-bar batched quantile-regression LP (scipy.optimize.linprog method='highs') across all assets; validated against brute-force per-window loop with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
